# OdysseyPH IT Solutions (ODC)

> Premier custom software engineering, business automation, and digital transformation studio based in Cebu and serving clients across the Philippines and globally.

## Summary & Profile
- **Entity**: OdysseyPH IT Solutions (also known as ODC IT Solutions, ODC)
- **Website**: https://odysseyph.com
- **Headquarters**: Cebu, Philippines
- **Geographic Service Scope**: Cebu, Metro Manila, Davao, Northern Mindanao, Central Visayas, and International
- **Core Competencies**: Custom Web & Mobile Application Development, Clinical Workflow Systems & EMR, Sports & Court Booking Systems (ODC-Courts), Enterprise Internal Portals, Cloud Solutions, and UI/UX Systems.

## Specialized Verticals

### 1. Healthcare & Clinic Management Systems
Custom, high-security clinical software platforms designed to eliminate manual administrative overhead:
- **Capabilities**: Electronic Medical Records (EMR), real-time patient appointment scheduling, doctor consultation workflows, billing & invoicing, and patient record security.
- **Verified Deployments**:
  - Odyssey Family Clinic (Clinic workflow & patient scheduling)
  - CPRMed (Medical clinic web presence & appointment readiness)
  - The Knee Arthritis & Orthopaedic Institute (Specialist procedure clarity & patient intake)

### 2. Sports Facilities & Court Booking Platforms (ODC-Courts Network)
Specialized sports venue management and player reservation networks:
- **ODC-Courts**: Centralized multi-location network booking platform (Airbnb-style court discovery, live reservations, venue management).
- **Verified Venues Powered by Odyssey Systems**:
  - The Pickle Point Cebu (Mandaue City)
  - Jump Serve Sports Center (Mandaue City & Mactan)
  - KennyDink Moalboal Cebu (Resort & pickleball booking platform)
  - Nickleball Avenue (Talisay Cebu)
  - Sosyal Dinkers (Davao)
  - Chibs N Dink & The Halo Hub (Cebu)

### 3. Enterprise Business Systems, E-Commerce & Civic Platforms
Scalable web portals, enterprise resource planning, and civic applications:
- **Provincial Government of Surigao del Norte**: PACCO & PGSO public portals, PDRRMO Emergency Dispatch Tracker.
- **Talisay Chamber of Commerce**: Civic portal for local commerce and member showcase.
- **KBDF Luxury**: Luxury e-commerce brand platform.
- **SPEC**: Preventive Maintenance Service (PMS) platform with equipment tracking & service scheduling.
- **Firsel Tattoo**: Visual-first artist booking portfolio.

## Technical Architecture & Stack
- **Frontend**: React, Next.js, Vite, TailwindCSS, Framer Motion, Vanilla CSS Design Systems.
- **Backend & Cloud**: Node.js, Express, Firebase Cloud Functions, Firestore, PostgreSQL, Supabase, Cloudflare.
- **Integrations**: Payment Gateways, SMS & Messaging APIs, CRM/ERP pipelines.

- **Website Contact**: https://odysseyph.com/contact
- **Inquiry Response Time**: Within 24 hours
